# 没有逐关节参考动作时，怎样用少量接触节拍训练多种双足步态？

> **当前答案：** 周期奖励可用相位、占空比和双腿相对相位，把足端接触力与摆动速度期望组合成站立、行走、跑步、跳跃等步态，而不逐关节复制轨迹。它只规定接触节拍；相位失配、足滑、冲击、力矩和硬件安全仍需独立约束与验证。

- MuJoCo/Cassie simulation used by the paper and pinned APEX implementation

## 控制器与方法

- phase-conditioned biped locomotion policy
- periodic-reward reinforcement learning

## 适用环境

- periodic standing, walking, running, hopping, and gait-transition tasks

## 成立假设

- A periodic phase variable and desired contact rhythm are meaningful for the target gait.
- Torque, impact, posture, and slip are checked outside the contact clock.

## 结果

- 周期奖励可用相位、占空比和双腿相对相位，把足端接触力与摆动速度期望组合成站立、行走、跑步、跳跃等步态，而不逐关节复制轨迹。它只规定接触节拍；相位失配、足滑、冲击、力矩和硬件安全仍需独立约束与验证。

## 限制

- A periodic phase variable and desired contact rhythm are meaningful for the target gait.
- Torque, impact, posture, and slip are checked outside the contact clock.

## 证据

- [Sim-to-Real Learning of All Common Bipedal Gaits via Periodic Reward Composition](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.01387v2>) — `support/primary`；Equations 4-6; Figures 1-5; Table I；Defines smooth periodic force/velocity coefficients, composes multiple gait rhythms, and reports simulated and real Cassie results.
- [osudrl/apex official implementation](<https://github.com/osudrl/apex/tree/82c44af2b5d7bffe884fd2f69856bb1b3c9948e0>) — `support/primary`；cassie/cassie.py and clock/reward configuration at 82c44af；Shows the official simulator and phase-clock reward path used for periodic-gait training and evaluation.
